answer_1.quote: This paper focuses on teaching LLMs to generate citations for retrieval-augmented longform question answering (LFQA)...

answer_2.quote: We follow the official metrics and nomenclature to measure correctness (via EM Recall), fluency (via MAUVE), and citation F1 (via an NLI‑trained T5‑11B model). Additional metrics include ROUGE‑L, FactScore, passage‑grounded correctness, and citation recall/precision.

answer_4.quote: Human subjects are tasked to judge the models' generations regarding: (i) citation recall, (ii) citation precision, (iii) informativeness, (iv) coherence, (v) fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each generated answer on citation recall, citation precision, informativeness, coherence, and fluency using a five‑point Likert scale.
